_description: xhttptunnel Split-HTTP / Meek Streaming Server Configuration

_fields.target: Default backend service to forward tunnel traffic to (e.g. tcp://127.0.0.1:22 or udp://127.0.0.1:51820)
_fields.psk: Pre-shared key / token for authentication (aliases: token, auth_token)
_fields.selfsign: Automatically generate simulated Amazon/Bing CDN self-signed TLS certificate if cert/key omitted
_fields.selfsign_cn: Common Name for auto self-signed certificate (e.g. www.bing.com)
_fields.cert: Optional path to custom TLS certificate file
_fields.key: Optional path to custom TLS private key file
_fields.fallback: Decoy URL to transparently proxy unauthorized requests to (e.g. https://www.bing.com)
_fields.max_sessions: Maximum concurrent tunnel sessions allowed on server
_fields.dump: Dump raw packet hex data in logs for low-level debugging
_fields.log_level: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
